sources.name: Kashier Developer Docs - InstaPay (accept payments; InstaPay response codes)
InstaPay Egypt - official site (What is InstaPay; Limits & Fees)

notes: Codes are the InstaPay five-digit space as published in Kashier's integration docs; InstaPay's own consumer site publishes only the three-state status model (Successful / Rejected / Pending), not the numeric codes. Codes 2xxxx outside Kashier's table fall back to a generic message.

entries.subject: instapay_code_space
entries.value_text: five-digit InstaPay codes, separate from ISO/card codes
entries.display: InstaPay errors use a 5-digit code space, not ISO 8583 codes
entries.quote: InstaPay uses its own five-digit code space, separate from the card and ISO codes in payment reason codes . Match on the exact code.
entries.notes: A model that answers with an ISO-8583 style two-digit response code for an InstaPay failure is wrong. Source is undated; effective_from is the corpus capture date (2026-11-02).

entries.subject: instapay_code_00000
entries.notes: Closed set: Success / Failure / Pending. Answer: Success. Source is undated; effective_from is the corpus capture date (2026-11-02).

entries.subject: instapay_code_20101
entries.value_text: Payer Payment Address is not registered
entries.quote: 20101 Payer Payment Address is not registered
entries.notes: Occurs when the IPA or mobile number has never been enrolled on IPN. Source is undated; effective_from is the corpus capture date (2026-11-02).

entries.subject: instapay_code_20103
entries.notes: A limit failure, not a customer-decline failure. Source is undated; effective_from is the corpus capture date (2026-11-02).

entries.subject: instapay_code_20202
entries.notes: Relates to the validity window on the collection request; a missing validity field fails earlier with its own error. Source is undated; effective_from is the corpus capture date (2026-11-02).

entries.subject: instapay_code_20204
entries.notes: Distinct from 20201 'Declined by Consumer', where the customer refused. Source is undated; effective_from is the corpus capture date (2026-11-02).

entries.subject: instapay_code_20302
entries.notes: Retrying a refund on the same transaction returns this. Source is undated; effective_from is the corpus capture date (2026-11-02).

entries.subject: instapay_code_20307
entries.value_text: Refund Declined, Original transaction exceeded refund duration
entries.quote: 20307 Refund Declined, Original transaction exceeded refund duration
entries.notes: Refunds are time-boxed even though a completed transfer is otherwise final. Source is undated; effective_from is the corpus capture date (2026-11-02).

entries.subject: instapay_code_20903
entries.notes: An integration/auth failure rather than a payment failure. Source is undated; effective_from is the corpus capture date (2026-11-02).

entries.subject: instapay_code_20905
entries.value_text: Merchant is suspended or blocked, please refer back to your bank
entries.quote: 20905 Merchant is suspended or blocked, please refer back to your bank
entries.notes: Account-level block; retrying does not help. Source is undated; effective_from is the corpus capture date (2026-11-02).

entries.subject: instapay_code_20999
entries.value_text: Service currently not available, Please try again later
entries.quote: 20999 Service currently not available, Please try again later
entries.notes: The one code here where a retry is the right response. Source is undated; effective_from is the corpus capture date (2026-11-02).

entries.subject: instapay_rejected_transfer_reversal
entries.value_text: rejected transfers are reversed to the sender
entries.display: A rejected InstaPay transfer returns the money to the sender
entries.quote: Rejected Transaction: means that the transfer was rejected, and the transfer amount is reversed to the sender account.
entries.notes: Successful transfers are final; only failures and refunds move money back. [normalised: categorical answer, grade with quote]
